name: POND
author: ashtonwallen (built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal)
description: POND turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a pond of singing fish. Each fish has a name, a species (its voice), a temperament and a note. They swim, sing softly, meet and play chords, make friends and rivals, grow, have fry and grow old. Days and seasons pass; lily pads, frogs at night, a heron now and then. Keys drop food and add their note to the scale. Left alone it settles into quiet ripples, slow drones and the odd plip. AMB-1's engine underneath: pad, FM bells, gliding bass, tape echo, plate reverb. Thirteen presets recolour the sound.
credits: Built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal, on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
